prompt:

Behind her, a richly painted background with layered painterly colour, subtle visible brushwork, atmospheric perspective and cinematic depth. Outfit: an oversized tee and shorts — in one bright, saturated colour such as cherry red, cobalt blue, sunflower yellow or kelly green; the outfit colour reads clearly at first glance, showing her shoulders, collarbones and legs as far as the outfit allows, following her curvy figure — a slim waist and rounded hips; intimate areas covered.

Leave behind everything she wears in the attached image — no crown, tiara, helmet, feathers, headpiece, hairpins from it, armour or regalia; her hair is styled for the everyday outfit, with at most one small accessory.

Her element — zirconium: a hard, corrosion-proof silver-grey metal named from a Persian word for gold-coloured, after the golden zircon gems of Ceylon in which it was found in 1789; zircon grains lock in uranium but shut out lead as they crystallize, so they keep time, and tiny grains from red Australian hills are about 4.4 billion years old, the oldest memories of the first solid Earth; zircon is also gathered from beach sands; melted zirconia grows into cubic zirconia, a flawless stone that throws even more rainbow fire than the diamond it imitates; the metal lets neutrons pass and so clads reactor fuel, once its near-identical twin hafnium is removed — may show in the outfit's details, motifs or small accessories.

Light: the place's own light, lit and coloured the way this style renders light and skin.
